summary.ja: アイルランドでは目立った危機のない平穏なニュースの日でした。株価指数は1か月で緩やかに上昇し、アイルランド代表チームはラグビーの試合に勝利しました。学生ビザ却下、ポートベロ研究所の資格に関する懸念、アイルランド統一をめぐる議論の報道は、通常の政策報道にとどまります。論調は世界平均よりやや否定的ですが、それだけで低いスコアを正当化するものではありません。
summary.ko: 아일랜드에서는 뚜렷한 위기가 없는 평범한 뉴스 하루였습니다. 주가지수는 한 달 동안 완만하게 상승했고, 아일랜드 럭비 대표팀은 경기에서 승리했습니다. 학생 비자 거부, 포르토벨로 연구소 자격 관련 우려, 아일랜드 통일 논쟁에 대한 보도는 일상적인 정책 보도에 해당합니다. 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 부정적이지만, 그것만으로 낮은 점수를 정당화하기에는 충분하지 않습니다.
summary.hi: आयरलैंड में एक सामान्य समाचार दिन रहा, जिसमें कोई स्पष्ट संकट नहीं था। शेयर सूचकांक एक महीने में मामूली रूप से बढ़ा और आयरिश टीम ने रग्बी मैच जीता, जबकि छात्र वीज़ा अस्वीकृतियों, पोर्टोबेलो इंस्टीट्यूट की योग्यताओं से जुड़ी चिंताओं और आयरिश एकीकरण पर बहस की कवरेज सामान्य नीतिगत रिपोर्टिंग है। स्वर विश्व औसत से थोड़ा अधिक नकारात्मक है, लेकिन केवल इसी आधार पर कम स्कोर उचित नहीं ठहरता।
summary.el: Μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα ειδήσεων στην Ιρλανδία χωρίς σαφή κρίση: ο δείκτης μετοχών αυξήθηκε μετρίως μέσα στον μήνα και η ιρλανδική ομάδα κέρδισε έναν αγώνα ράγκμπι, ενώ η κάλυψη των αρνήσεων φοιτητικής βίζας, των ανησυχιών για τα πιστοποιητικά του Portobello Institute και της συζήτησης για την ενότητα της Ιρλανδίας είναι συνηθισμένη πολιτική ενημέρωση. Ο τόνος είναι ελαφρώς πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, but αυτό από μόνο του δεν δικαιολογεί χαμηλότερη βαθμολογία.
summary.it: Una giornata di notizie ordinaria in Irlanda, senza una crisi evidente: l'indice di borsa è salito moderatamente nel corso del mese e la squadra irlandese ha vinto una partita di rugby, mentre la copertura su rifiuti di visti per studenti, preoccupazioni sulle qualifiche del Portobello Institute e dibattito sull'unità irlandese è un normale resoconto di politiche pubbliche. Il tono è leggermente più negativo della media mondiale, ma ciò da solo non giustifica un punteggio più basso.
summary.ru: Обычный новостной день в Ирландии без явного кризиса: фондовый индекс за месяц умеренно вырос, а ирландская команда выиграла матч по регби, тогда как освещение отказов в студенческих визах, обеспокоенности по поводу квалификаций Portobello Institute и дебатов об объединении Ирландии представляет собой обычную политическую хронику. Тон немного более негативный, чем в среднем по миру, но это само по себе не оправдывает более низкую оценку.
summary.ar: يوم إخباري اعتيادي في أيرلندا دون أزمة واضحة: ارتفع مؤشر الأسهم بشكل طفيف خلال الشهر وفاز المنتخب الأيرلندي في مباراة للرغبي، بينما تُعد التغطية الخاصة برفض تأشيرات الطلاب والمخاوف بشأن مؤهلات معهد بورتوبيلو وجدل وحدة أيرلندا تقارير سياسية عادية. النبرة أكثر سلبية قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي، لكن ذلك وحده لا يبرر درجة أدنى.
summary.fa: یک روز خبری معمولی در ایرلند بدون بحران آشکار: شاخص سهام در طول یک ماه به میزان اندکی افزایش یافت و تیم ایرلند یک مسابقه راگبی را برد، در حالی که پوشش خبری رد شدن ویزای دانشجویی، نگرانی‌ها درباره مدارک مؤسسه پورتوبلو و بحث وحدت ایرلند، گزارش‌دهی معمول سیاسی است. لحن کمی منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، اما این به تنهایی نمره پایین‌تر را توجیه نمی‌کند.
summary.zh: 爱尔兰的一个普通新闻日，没有明显危机：股票指数在一个月内小幅上涨，爱尔兰国家橄榄球队赢得一场比赛；而关于学生签证拒签、Portobello Institute资格问题以及爱尔兰统一辩论的报道属于常规政策报道。语气比全球平均水平略为负面，但这本身并不足以支持较低的评分。
summary.tr: İrlanda'da kriz içermeyen sıradan bir haber günü: hisse endeksi bir ay içinde mütevazı biçimde yükseldi ve İrlanda takımı bir ragbi maçını kazandı; öğrenci vizesi reddleri, Portobello Institute yeterlilikleriyle ilgili endişeler ve İrlanda birliği tartışması ise olağan politika haberciliğidir. Ton dünya ortalamasından biraz daha olumsuz, ancak bu tek başına daha düşük bir puanı gerektirmiyor.
summary.es: Un día de noticias rutinario en Irlanda, sin una crisis clara: el índice bursátil subió modestamente a lo largo del mes y el equipo irlandés ganó un partido de rugby, mientras que la cobertura de las denegaciones de visados de estudiante, las preocupaciones sobre las titulaciones del Portobello Institute y el debate sobre la unidad irlandesa es periodismo de políticas ordinario. El tono es algo más negativo que la media mundial, pero eso por sí solo no justifica una puntuación más baja.
summary.fr: Une journée d'actualité ordinaire en Irlande, sans crise manifeste : l'indice boursier a progressé modestement sur le mois et l'équipe irlandaise a remporté un match de rugby, tandis que la couverture des refus de visas étudiants, des préoccupations concernant les qualifications de le Portobello Institute et du débat sur l'unité irlandaise relève d'un reportage politique ordinaire. Le ton est légèrement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, mais cela ne suffit pas à justifier une note plus basse.
summary.de: Ein routinemäßiger Nachrichtentag in Irland ohne eindeutige Krise: Der Aktienindex stieg im Monatsverlauf moderat, und die irische Rugbymannschaft gewann ein Spiel, während die Berichterstattung über abgelehnte Studentenvisa, Bedenken zu den Abschlüssen des Portobello Institute und die Debatte über die irische Einheit gewöhnliche politische Berichterstattung ist. Der Ton ist etwas negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, was allein jedoch keine niedrigere Bewertung rechtfertigt.
summary.pt: Um dia de notícias rotineiro na Irlanda, sem uma crise clara: o índice da bolsa subiu modestamente ao longo do mês e a equipa irlandesa venceu uma partida de rugby, enquanto a cobertura das recusas de vistos de estudante, as preocupações com as qualificações do Portobello Institute e o debate sobre a unidade irlandesa constitui jornalismo de políticas comum. O tom é ligeiramente mais negativo do que a média mundial, mas isso por si só não justifica uma pontuação mais baixa.

summary.en: During the Durga Puja period there are positive signs, such as Prime Minister Tarık Rahman's efforts to reassure minorities and interest in investment in an LNG terminal. However, the resignation of a minister over a scandal involving an armed drug raid, a traffic accident that killed 14 people, dengue and measles outbreaks, Hasina's threats of return, and claims of unrest within the army are disturbing the balance. The overall picture is close to the normal period, slightly negative.

en: The Prime Minister's Durga Puja visits and message of interfaith harmony
Minister İshrak Hüseyin's resignation after the armed drug raid scandal
Dengue fever deaths and child deaths in the measles outbreak
Hasina's return statements and political tension
A severe traffic accident and the execution of two Bangladeshi citizens in Saudi Arabia

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance news with negative items: 357 dengue deaths, Saudi executions of two Bangladeshis without notice, and party resignations. Positive signals include the PM's interfaith harmony messaging during Durga Puja and infrastructure and digital-payment announcements, so the net picture is roughly ordinary.

en: Dengue death toll reaches 357 for the year
Saudi Arabia executed two Bangladeshis without prior notice to Dhaka
PM's interfaith harmony messaging during Durga Puja celebrations

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine, with the Durga Puja festival ending peacefully and a Bangladesh-Algeria hydrocarbons MoU signed. Against that, dengue and measles deaths, a Saudi execution of two nationals, a political killing and a train derailment weigh on the score, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Measles deaths reach 1,147 amid weak immunisation coverage
Dengue: 7 more deaths and 1,373 hospitalised in one day
Saudi execution of two Bangladeshi nationals draws diplomatic attention

summary.en: The period mixes positive news, such as a $6.35bn Japanese investment pledge and returned detainees, with negative items: a dengue death toll of 368, measles deaths, road crashes, and an army evacuation of tourists from Sajek amid unrest. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines describe a mostly routine day with no clear new crisis.

en: Japan plans $6.35bn private investment in Bangladesh over five years
Dengue deaths reach 368 and measles deaths reported
Army evacuates over 2,000 tourists from Sajek amid unrest

summary.en: The period mixes serious problems with routine news: a measles outbreak with about 200 child deaths, protests over Bangladeshi executions in Saudi Arabia, and blockades in the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Positive signals include a peaceful Durga Puja and a planned solar power plant, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Measles outbreak with about 200 child deaths in total
Protests over executions of Bangladeshis in Saudi Arabia
Road and waterway blockades in Khagrachhari and Rangamati

summary.en: The period mixes serious health and safety problems, including a measles outbreak with 1,118 reported deaths, rising dengue cases and 281 road deaths in 13 days, with political shootings and a journalist's murder. Offsetting positives include a reportedly peaceful Durga Puja, a Rooppur nuclear unit completing its physics test, and steady tourism.

en: Measles toll reaches 1,118 with more child deaths reported
Political shooting in Khulna and a journalist's murder
Rooppur first unit completes physics test ahead of power generation

summary.en: The period mixes serious public-health strains (dengue at a year high, measles deaths, a gas shortage closing a fertiliser plant) and security frictions, including a BSF incident and obstruction of a trial witness's burial. Positives include an IMF-linked per capita GDP forecast and accountability steps such as arrests and a chargesheet, but the overall tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Dengue cases hit year-high; 2,249 new cases in 24 hours
Measles deaths and rising case count reported
Gas shortage forces Jamuna fertiliser plant shutdown again

summary.en: The period is marked by a serious measles outbreak, rising dengue deaths, gas shortages, and reports of arrests for online criticism of the government and a violent attack on a party office. Positive signals include a large Dhaka Metro contract win and plans to relax bank dollar-holding limits, and the negative news tone is well below the world average.

en: Measles outbreak with reported deaths and spreading fears
Arrests for criticising government online and police clashes in Gopalganj
Gas shortage idling Ashuganj fertiliser factory

summary.en: The day mixed routine governance and development news, including Rooppur nuclear fuel delivery, a large metro contract and a cyclone that weakened without major damage. Negatives included measles and dengue deaths, opposition allegations of mass arrests, a party office attack and the 'crossfire' controversy, but GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Rooppur nuclear plant reaching fuel and first-unit readiness milestones
Cyclone Arnab weakened after landfall in India with no reported damage
Measles and dengue deaths rising, with 17 deaths reported in 24 hours

summary.en: The period shows routine political friction, including a by-election dispute and opposition threats of street protests if the vote is not fair. Localised communal violence, a measles outbreak and the expiring Ganges treaty add to the strain, partly offset by a reported $6.3bn Japanese investment plan.

en: Fatal stabbing of a Hindu man and vandalism of homes
Opposition alliance threatens street agitation over by-election fairness
Ganges water treaty set to expire; energy pressures

summary.en: The period mixes serious concerns, including a murder case with police questioning, mob killings, child sexual abuse outrage, and rising measles deaths, with modest positives such as a three-year LDC graduation deferment and a nuclear plant power generation approval. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Ex-air force officer Tahsif Souri's death and ongoing police probe
Mob killings persist despite pledges of action
Child sexual abuse cases at six madrasas spark outrage

summary.en: The period mixes clear positives, including a three-year UN extension of LDC graduation and the Rooppur nuclear plant reaching criticality, with political friction such as an 11-party long march and Jamaat warnings to the government. The unexplained death of a former Air Force officer and reports of dismissed Hindu university staff add concern, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: UN grants Bangladesh three more years for LDC graduation
Rooppur nuclear plant reaches criticality
Political tensions: 11-party long march and referendum warnings

summary.en: Violent garment-worker wage protests in Mirpur, with a police vehicle burned, dozens of factories shut and BGB deployed, dominate the period. Partial offsets include the government forming a wage board and Rooppur's first electricity, alongside a rising dengue death toll.

en: Violent garment wage protests, police clashes and factory closures
BGB deployed to garment hubs amid unrest
Government forms wage board to address workers' demands

summary.en: Garment-sector wage protests turned violent over three days, with tear gas, police vehicles torched, and about 529 factories shut, while mob violence and crackdown arrests add to the strain. A wage board was announced and US investment talks continued, but the disruption to a major export sector and the security situation weigh heavily.

en: Garment wage protests with clashes, tear gas and police vehicles torched
529 factories shut, export orders at risk
Mass arrests and thousands accused in protest cases

summary.en: Multi-day garment worker wage protests have shut hundreds of factories in Gazipur, Savar and Ashulia, with clashes, arson, police vehicles torched and mass case filings against thousands. Routine positives, such as a Korea investment task force and AmCham trade activity, do not offset the serious labour unrest and crackdown.

en: Garment wage protests shut hundreds of factories across Gazipur, Savar and Ashulia
Clashes with police, tear gas and arson; thousands named in cases
Mass arrests and political blame directed at Awami League-linked figures

summary.en: Garment worker wage protests turned violent over several days, with police clashes, arrests, nearly 1,000 factories shut and military deployments, while reprisals against academics were reported. A late-period government agreement to raise garment minimum pay offers some de-escalation, but the overall picture is serious unrest and economic disruption.

en: Garment wage protests with police clashes and arrests
Nearly 1,000 factories shut, hitting the export economy
Government agrees to raise garment minimum pay

summary.en: Garment workers' wage protests led to factory closures, clashes with police and deployment of additional paramilitary forces, and rights reports describe political reprisals and rising violence. Partly offsetting this, the government agreed to a new garment pay scale from December and signed a China infrastructure MoU and a major Mongla port project.

en: Garment wage protests cause hundreds of factory closures and police clashes
Government agrees to raise garment worker pay from December
HRW reports reprisals against academics and students

summary.en: Garment-sector unrest turned violent, with injuries, factory closures and a reported police crackdown drawing rights-group condemnation, and a border clash killed a soldier. Partly offsetting this, workers were returning to factories, and there were new investment announcements such as the Mongla Port expansion, fertilizer plants and a China MoU.

en: Garment worker protests turned violent; factories shut and police used tear gas
Rights groups condemn crackdown on protesting garment workers
Mongla Port expansion and new fertilizer plants announced

summary.en: The period is a mix of routine government announcements, a national-day speech and new trade and port investment, offset by a defaced Tagore mural, a rights-body criticism of a journalist's imprisonment, unconfirmed reports of bodies in Teknaf hills, and a deposed leader's vow to return. GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average, but no acute crisis is reported, so the score sits near an ordinary day.

en: Mongla Port expansion groundbreaking and Russia trade pact signed
Rights body criticises imprisonment of senior journalist
Tagore mural defaced in Khulna, sparking outrage

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains, including labour unrest with 33 BGB platoons deployed, a measles death toll of 1,280, an LPG supply disruption, and factional political violence. Positive news such as a record Test innings, a Russia trade pact and a royal visit does not offset these, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Labour unrest prompting deployment of 33 BGB platoons to industrial hubs
Measles outbreak death toll rising to 1,280
LPG supply disruption and higher cooking gas prices

summary.en: A mixed, mostly routine day: Sheikh Hasina's passport bid and BNP's rejection add political tension, and border guards were deployed to industrial areas over labour unrest. A measles outbreak, debt and banking pressures weigh on the picture, but there are no clear crises and no large-scale violence.

en: Hasina's passport request and BNP's rejection raise political tension
Border guard deployment to three industrial zones over labour unrest
Measles death toll above 1,280 with new cases

summary.en: The period is dominated by political violence: arson attacks, crude bomb blasts across Dhaka and other districts, a bus driver burnt alive, and BGB deployments amid garment worker unrest. Reports of the security situation deteriorating outweigh the few routine items, which places this well into serious-problems territory without reaching war or state collapse.

en: Nationwide arson and crude bomb blasts, including over 50 blasts in Dhaka
Bus driver burnt alive during Chhatra League blockade and arson
34 BGB platoons deployed amid garment worker unrest

summary.en: Over the past day, Bangladesh saw widespread political violence, including reports of over 100 crude bomb blasts, arson on vehicles and party offices, and at least one death, tied to a Chhatra League blockade and tensions over Sheikh Hasina's planned return. Garment wage protests, measles deaths and a rise in Awami League arrests add to the strain, though inflation eased slightly and the violence falls short of war or state collapse.

en: Nationwide crude bomb blasts and arson attacks reported across the country
BNP office torched and bus driver killed in blockade-linked violence
Tensions over Sheikh Hasina's planned return and death-sentence rhetoric

summary.en: The period was dominated by a wave of crude bomb blasts and vehicle arson, with a measles death toll of 1,295 and renewed political tension over Hasina's vow to return. Positive items, including a Dhaka Metro contract, added hospital beds and international recognition for Invest Bangladesh, were outweighed by the violence and public-health strain.

en: Over 100 crude bomb blasts and vehicle arson reported nationwide
Measles outbreak toll reaches 1,295 with new deaths
Hindu temple vandalised and a Hindu man murdered

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a measles outbreak with rising child deaths (toll reported at 1,299), reports of attacks on Hindu minorities and a temple vandalised, political clashes over an MP's burned house, and labour unrest that shut 204 factories. Modest positives such as $30 million in climate finance and falling vegetable prices do not offset these, and GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Measles outbreak: child deaths rising, national toll reported at 1,299
Attacks on minorities and Durga temple vandalised, Hindu man killed
Labour unrest: 204 factories closed, 9 shut indefinitely

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: economic and social features, a nuclear fuel delivery to Rooppur, and new gas exploration plans. Negatives include a diplomatic row with India over Sheikh Hasina's extradition, postponed consular talks, measles child deaths in Sylhet, and a violent robbery of students, but none signals a crisis.

en: Diplomatic row with India over Sheikh Hasina extradition
Measles deaths of children in Sylhet
Rooppur nuclear plant receives sixth uranium shipment

summary.en: Mixed period: security deployments and killings in Khulna, a dengue surge, and a garment-sector wage dispute weigh against progress on the Rooppur nuclear project and food-supply assurances. Political tension over Hasina's possible return and BNP-Jamaat rivalry adds strain, but no crisis or mass unrest is reported.

en: Khulna killings and extortion leave police struggling to restore order
Garment makers threaten to quit wage talks and shut factories
Dengue hospitalisations and deaths rising, 1,674 patients reported

summary.en: Gopalganj saw violent clashes, arson and property damage linked to banned Awami League activity, with heavy security deployments and a planned Hasina return raising tensions. Garment workers faced tear gas over wage disputes and dozens of factories shut, though some business sentiment was upbeat.
summary.tr: Gopalganj'da yasaklı Awami Ligi faaliyetleriyle bağlantılı şiddetli çatışmalar, kundaklama ve mal hasarı yaşandı; yoğun güvenlik önlemleri ve Hasina'nın planlanan dönüşü gerilimi artırdı. Hazır giyim işçileri ücret anlaşmazlıkları nedeniyle göz yaşartıcı gazla karşılaştı ve düzinelerce fabrika kapandı, ancak bazı iş dünyası görüşleri iyimserdi.
summary.es: Gopalganj fue escenario de enfrentamientos violentos, incendios provocados y daños materiales vinculados a actividades de la Liga Awami prohibida, con un fuerte despliegue de seguridad y el previsto regreso de Hasina, lo que aumenta las tensiones. Los trabajadores textiles sufrieron gas lacrimógeno por disputas salariales y decenas de fábricas cerraron, aunque el ánimo empresarial era optimista en algunos sectores.
summary.fr: Gopalganj a connu de violents affrontements, des incendies criminels et des dégâts matériels liés à des activités de la Ligue Awami interdite, avec un fort déploiement sécuritaire et le retour prévu d'Hasina, qui accroît les tensions. Les ouvriers du textile ont été visés par des gaz lacrymogènes lors de conflits salariaux et des dizaines d'usines ont fermé, bien que le sentiment des milieux d'affaires soit optimiste dans certains secteurs.
summary.de: In Gopalganj kam es zu gewaltsamen Zusammenstößen, Brandstiftung und Sachschäden im Zusammenhang mit verbotenen Aktivitäten der Awami-Liga; massive Sicherheitskräfte und die geplante Rückkehr Hasinas verschärfen die Spannungen. Textilarbeiter wurden wegen Lohnstreitigkeiten mit Tränengas konfrontiert, und Dutzende Fabriken wurden geschlossen, wobei die Stimmung in Teilen der Wirtschaft dennoch optimistisch war.
summary.pt: Gopalganj registrou confrontos violentos, incêndios criminosos e danos materiais ligados a atividades da Liga Awami proibida, com forte mobilização de segurança e o retorno planejado de Hasina elevando as tensões. Trabalhadores do vestuário foram alvo de gás lacrimogêneo em disputas salariais e dezenas de fábricas fecharam, embora o sentimento empresarial fosse otimista em alguns setores.
summary.it: Gopalganj ha registrato scontri violenti, incendi dolosi e danni alla proprietà legati all'attività della Awami League, messa al bando, con un ingente schieramento di forze di sicurezza e il previsto ritorno di Hasina che alimenta le tensioni. I lavoratori del settore tessile hanno subito gas lacrimogeni per controversie salariali e decine di fabbriche hanno chiuso, sebbene il sentiment di alcune imprese resti ottimista.
summary.ru: В Гопалгандже произошли ожесточённые столкновения, поджоги и повреждения имущества, связанные с деятельностью запрещённой Лиги Авами; значительные силы безопасности были развёрнуты, а запланированное возвращение Хасины усиливает напряжённость. Работники текстильной промышленности подверглись воздействию слезоточивого газа из-за споров об оплате труда, и закрылись десятки фабрик, хотя настроения части деловых кругов остаются оптимистичными.
summary.ar: شهدت غوبالغانج اشتباكات عنيفة وحرائق متعمدة وأضرارًا بالممتلكات مرتبطة بنشاط رابطة عوامي المحظورة، مع نشر أمني مكثف وتصاعد التوترات مع العودة المخطط لها لحسينة. وتعرض عمال الملابس للغاز المسيل للدموع بسبب نزاعات الأجور، وأُغلقت عشرات المصانع، رغم أن معنويات بعض قطاع الأعمال كانت متفائلة.
summary.fa: در گوپالگنج درگیری‌های خشونت‌آمیز، آتش‌سوزی عمدی و خسارت به اموال در ارتباط با فعالیت لیگ عوامی ممنوع‌شده رخ داد، با استقرار گسترده نیروهای امنیتی و بازگشت برنامه‌ریزی‌شده حسینه که تنش‌ها را افزایش می‌دهد. کارگران صنعت پوشاک در پی اختلافات دستمزدی با گاز اشک‌آور مواجه شدند و ده‌ها کارخانه تعطیل شدند، هرچند برخی فضاهای کسب‌وکار خوش‌بینانه بودند.
summary.zh: 戈帕尔甘杰发生暴力冲突、纵火和财产损失，与被禁止的人民联盟活动有关；大规模安保部署及计划中的哈西娜回国加剧了紧张局势。服装工人因工资纠纷遭到催泪瓦斯驱散，数十家工厂停工，但部分商界情绪仍较乐观。
summary.ja: ゴパルガンジでは、禁止されているアワミ連盟の活動に関連して激しい衝突、放火、財産への被害が発生した。厳重な警備配置が行われ、ハシナ氏の帰国計画が緊張を高めている。衣料品労働者は賃金争議をめぐり催涙ガスを浴び、数十の工場が操業を停止した。一方で、一部では企業心理は前向きだった。
summary.ko: 고팔간지에서는 금지된 아와미연맹 활동과 관련된 폭력 충돌, 방화 및 재산 피해가 발생했다. 대규모 보안 병력이 배치된 가운데 하시나의 귀국 계획으로 긴장이 고조되고 있다. 의류 노동자들은 임금 분쟁과 관련해 최루가스를 맞았고 수십 개 공장이 문을 닫았으나, 일부 기업 심리는 낙관적이었다.
summary.hi: गोपालगंज में प्रतिबंधित अवामी लीग गतिविधियों से जुड़ी हिंसक झड़पें, आगज़नी और संपत्ति को नुकसान हुआ। भारी सुरक्षा तैनाती और हसीना की प्रस्तावित वापसी से तनाव बढ़ रहा है। वेतन विवादों को लेकर गारमेंट कर्मचारियों पर आंसू गैस छोड़ी गई और दर्जनों कारखाने बंद हो गए, हालांकि कुछ व्यावसायिक भावना सकारात्मक रही।
summary.el: Το Γκοπαλγκάντζ σημείωσε βίαιες συγκρούσεις, εμπρησμούς και υλικές ζημιές που συνδέονται με την απαγορευμένη δραστηριότητα της Awami League, με μεγάλη ανάπτυξη δυνάμεων ασφαλείας και τον προγραμματισμένο επαναπατρισμό της Χασίνα να αυξάνει την ένταση. Εργάτες της ένδυσης αντιμετώπισαν δακρυγόνα λόγω διαφωνιών για μισθούς και δεκάδες εργοστάσια έκλεισαν, αν και το επιχειρηματικό κλίμα ήταν κάπως αισιόδοξο.

summary.zh: 该时段的报道稀少且大多偏离主题，仅有一条国内新闻标题，涉及12月的一次集会、一处度假村的拍卖以及纳希德案。没有明显的危机或重大进展，GDELT的正面语气仅基于8篇文章。
summary.tr: Dönem için haber kapsamı az ve çoğunlukla konu dışı; yalnızca Aralık ayındaki bir toplanma, bir tatil beldesi müzayedesi ve Nasheed davasıyla ilgili tek bir yerel haber başlığı var. Net bir kriz ya da önemli bir gelişme görünmüyor ve GDELT'in olumlu tonu yalnızca 8 habere dayanıyor.
summary.es: La cobertura del período es escasa y en su mayoría no guarda relación con el tema; solo hay un titular nacional sobre una concentración en diciembre, una subasta de un complejo turístico y el caso de Nasheed. No aparece una crisis clara ni un desarrollo importante, y el tono positivo de GDELT se basa en solo 8 artículos.
summary.fr: La couverture médiatique de la période est maigre et largement hors sujet : seul un titre national porte sur un rassemblement de décembre, une vente aux enchères d'un complexe hôtelier et l'affaire Nasheed. Aucune crise nette ni évolution majeure n'apparaît, et le ton positif de GDELT repose sur seulement 8 articles.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung über den Zeitraum ist dünn und größtenteils themenfremd; es gibt nur eine inländische Schlagzeile zu einer Versammlung im Dezember, einer Versteigerung eines Ferienresorts und dem Fall Nasheed. Eine klare Krise oder eine bedeutende Entwicklung ist nicht erkennbar, und der positive GDELT-Tonwert stützt sich auf nur 8 Artikel.
summary.pt: A cobertura do período é escassa e, em sua maioria, fora do tema; há apenas uma manchete nacional sobre uma reunião em dezembro, um leilão de um resort e o caso de Nasheed. Não surgem uma crise clara nem um desenvolvimento importante, e o tom positivo do GDELT baseia-se em apenas 8 artigos.
summary.ja: 当該期間の報道は少なく、大半が主題から外れています。国内の見出しは12月の集会、リゾートの競売、ナシード氏の訴訟に関するもの1件のみです。明確な危機や重大な進展は確認されず、GDELTの肯定的なトーンは8件の記事に基づくものにすぎません。
summary.ko: 해당 기간의 보도는 적고 대부분 주제와 무관합니다. 국내 헤드라인은 12월 집회, 리조트 경매, 나시드 사건을 다룬 한 건뿐입니다. 뚜렷한 위기나 주요 진전은 확인되지 않으며, GDELT의 긍정적 어조도 8건의 기사에만 근거합니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की कवरेज कम है और अधिकतर विषय से हटकर है। केवल एक घरेलू सुर्खी है, जो दिसंबर की एक सभा, एक रिसॉर्ट की नीलामी और नशीद के मामले से जुड़ी है। कोई स्पष्ट संकट या बड़ा घटनाक्रम नहीं दिखता, और GDELT का सकारात्मक स्वर केवल 8 लेखों पर आधारित है।
summary.el: Η κάλυψη για την περίοδο είναι περιορισμένη και κυρίως άσχετη με το θέμα. Υπάρχει μόνο ένας εγχώριος τίτλος, για μια συγκέντρωση τον Δεκέμβριο, τη δημοπρασία ενός θέρετρου και την υπόθεση του Nasheed. Δεν εμφανίζεται σαφής κρίση ή σημαντική εξέλιξη, και ο θετικός τόνος του GDELT βασίζεται μόνο σε 8 άρθρα.

summary.hi: स्लोवेनिया में 15 नवंबर को नियमित स्थानीय चुनाव हुए, जिनमें 167 नगरपालिकाओं में मेयर चुने गए और 45 में पुनर्मतदान हुआ। इनमें लुब्लियाना और मारिबोर भी शामिल हैं। चुनाव प्रक्रिया सुव्यवस्थित लगती है, सुर्खियों में कोई संकट या अशांति नहीं है, और चट्टान गिरने से हुई चोट तथा नशीले पदार्थों के गिरोह के भंडाफोड़ जैसी छोटी घटनाएँ सामान्य हैं।
summary.el: Η Σλοβενία διεξήγαγε τακτικές τοπικές εκλογές στις 15 Νοεμβρίου, με εκλογή δημάρχων σε 167 δήμους και δεύτερους γύρους σε 45, μεταξύ των οποίων η Λιουμπλιάνα και το Μάριμπορ. Η διαδικασία φαίνεται οργανωμένη, χωρίς κρίση ή αναταραχή στα πρωτοσέλιδα, και τα μικρά περιστατικά (τραυματισμός από κατολίσθηση βράχων, εξάρθρωση κυκλώματος ναρκωτικών) είναι συνηθισμένα.
summary.tr: Slovenya, 15 Kasım'da rutin yerel seçimlerini yaptı; 167 belediyede belediye başkanı seçildi, 45 belediyede ise ikinci tur yapıldı. Bunlar arasında Ljubljana ve Maribor da yer alıyor. Süreç düzenli görünüyor; manşetlerde kriz ya da huzursuzluk yok, küçük olaylar (bir kaya düşmesi sonucu yaralanma ve bir uyuşturucu çetesinin çökertilmesi) ise rutin niteliğinde.
summary.es: Eslovenia celebró el 15 de noviembre sus elecciones locales rutinarias, con alcaldes elegidos en 167 municipios y segundas vueltas en 45, incluidas Liubliana y Maribor. El proceso parece ordenado, sin crisis ni disturbios en los titulares, y los incidentes menores (un herido por desprendimiento de rocas y una redada contra una banda de narcotráfico) son rutinarios.
summary.fr: La Slovénie a organisé le 15 novembre ses élections locales de routine, avec l'élection de maires dans 167 communes et des second tours dans 45 d'entre elles, dont Ljubljana et Maribor. Le scrutin semble s'être déroulé dans l'ordre, sans crise ni troubles à la une, et les incidents mineurs (un blessé par une chute de pierres et le démantèlement d'un gang de trafiquants de drogue) sont de routine.
summary.de: Slowenien hat am 15. November seine routinemäßigen Kommunalwahlen abgehalten; in 167 Gemeinden wurden Bürgermeister gewählt, in 45 Gemeinden fanden Stichwahlen statt, darunter in Ljubljana und Maribor. Der Ablauf wirkt geordnet, in den Schlagzeilen finden sich keine Krise und keine Unruhen, und die kleineren Vorfälle (eine Verletzung durch Steinschlag und die Zerschlagung einer Drogenbande) sind alltäglicher Natur.
summary.pt: A Eslovénia realizou no dia 15 de novembro as suas eleições autárquicas de rotina, com a eleição de presidentes de câmara em 167 municípios e segundas voltas em 45, incluindo Ljubljana e Maribor. O processo parece decorrer de forma ordeira, sem crise ou agitação nas manchetes, e os incidentes menores (um ferido por queda de pedras e a desarticulação de um gangue de tráfico de droga) são de rotina.
summary.it: La Slovenia ha tenuto le elezioni locali ordinarie il 15 novembre, con l'elezione dei sindaci in 167 comuni e ballottaggi in 45, tra cui Lubiana e Maribor. Il processo appare regolare, senza crisi o disordini nei titoli, e gli incidenti minori (il ferimento per una frana e un'operazione contro una banda di narcotrafficanti) sono di routine.
summary.ru: Словения провела плановые местные выборы 15 ноября: мэры были избраны в 167 муниципалитетах, во втором туре — в 45, включая Любляну и Марибор. Процесс выглядит организованным, в заголовках нет ни кризиса, ни беспорядков, а мелкие инциденты (ранение при обвале породы и разгром наркогруппировки) носят рутинный характер.
summary.ar: أجرت سلوفينيا انتخابات محلية روتينية في 15 نوفمبر، حيث انتُخب رؤساء البلديات في 167 بلدية، وأُجريت جولات إعادة في 45 بلدية، من بينها ليوبليانا وماريبور. ويبدو أن العملية جرت بسلاسة، دون أزمة أو اضطرابات في العناوين، والحوادث الطفيفة (إصابة بسبب انهيار صخري وضبط عصابة للمخدرات) روتينية.
summary.fa: اسلوونی در ۱۵ نوامبر انتخابات محلی معمول خود را برگزار کرد که در آن شهرداران ۱۶۷ شهرداری انتخاب شدند و دور دوم در ۴۵ شهرداری از جمله لیوبلیانا و ماریبور برگزار شد. روند به نظر منظم می‌رسد و در تیترها خبری از بحران یا ناآرامی نیست، و حوادث جزئی (زخمی شدن بر اثر ریزش سنگ و کشف یک باند قاچاق مواد مخدر) امری روتین است.
summary.zh: 斯洛文尼亚于11月15日举行例行地方选举，167个市选出市长，45个市进行决选，其中包括卢布尔雅那和马里博尔。选举过程看似井然有序，头条新闻中没有危机或骚乱，而小规模事件（一人因落石受伤以及一起毒品团伙被破获）属于日常新闻。

en: Local elections completed orderly, with runoffs in 45 municipalities
Ljubljana mayoral race goes to a runoff, a notable but routine outcome
Routine incidents: rockfall injury and drug-gang bust
ja: 地方選挙は秩序立って完了し、45の自治体で決選投票が行われた
リュブリャナの市長選は決選投票に持ち越され、注目すべきだが日常的な結果である
落石による負傷と麻薬密売組織の摘発という日常的な出来事
ko: 지방선거가 질서정연하게 마무리되었으며, 45개 지방자치단체에서 결선투표가 실시됨
류블랴나 시장 선거가 결선투표로 넘어갔으며, 주목할 만하지만 일상적인 결과임
낙석 부상 및 마약 조직 검거 등 일상적인 사건
hi: स्थानीय चुनाव सुव्यवस्थित ढंग से संपन्न हुए, 45 नगरपालिकाओं में पुनर्मतदान हुआ
लुब्लियाना के मेयर पद की दौड़ पुनर्मतदान तक पहुँची, जो उल्लेखनीय किंतु सामान्य परिणाम है
सामान्य घटनाएँ: चट्टान गिरने से चोट और नशीले पदार्थों के गिरोह का भंडाफोड़
el: Οι τοπικές εκλογές ολοκληρώθηκαν με τάξη, με δεύτερους γύρους σε 45 δήμους
Η εκλογή δημάρχου στη Λιουμπλιάνα πάει σε δεύτερο γύρο, ένα αξιοσημείωτο αλλά συνηθισμένο αποτέλεσμα
Συνηθισμένα περιστατικά: τραυματισμός από κατολίσθηση βράχων και εξάρθρωση κυκλώματος ναρκωτικών
tr: Yerel seçimler düzenli biçimde tamamlandı; 45 belediyede ikinci tur yapıldı
Ljubljana belediye başkanlığı yarışı ikinci tura kaldı; dikkat çekici ama rutin bir sonuç
Rutin olaylar: kaya düşmesi sonucu yaralanma ve uyuşturucu çetesi operasyonu
es: Las elecciones locales se completaron de forma ordenada, con segundas vueltas en 45 municipios
La contienda por la alcaldía de Liubliana irá a segunda vuelta, un resultado notable pero rutinario
Incidentes rutinarios: un herido por desprendimiento de rocas y la desarticulación de una banda de narcotráfico
fr: Élections locales achevées dans l'ordre, avec des second tours dans 45 communes
La course à la mairie de Ljubljana se joue au second tour, un résultat notable mais de routine
Incidents de routine : un blessé par une chute de pierres et le démantèlement d'un gang de trafiquants de drogue
de: Kommunalwahlen geordnet abgeschlossen, mit Stichwahlen in 45 Gemeinden
Das Bürgermeisterrennen in Ljubljana geht in die Stichwahl, ein bemerkenswertes, aber routinemäßiges Ergebnis
Routinemäßige Vorfälle: Verletzung durch Steinschlag und Zerschlagung einer Drogenbande
pt: Eleições autárquicas concluídas de forma ordeira, com segundas voltas em 45 municípios
A corrida à presidência da câmara de Ljubljana vai à segunda volta, um resultado notável mas de rotina
Incidentes de rotina: um ferido por queda de pedras e a desarticulação de um gangue de tráfico de droga
it: Elezioni locali concluse in modo regolare, con ballottaggi in 45 comuni
La corsa a sindaco di Lubiana va al ballottaggio, un esito rilevante ma di routine
Incidenti di routine: ferito per una frana e arresto di una banda di narcotrafficanti
ru: Местные выборы прошли организованно, второй тур состоится в 45 муниципалитетах
Выборы мэра Любляны переходят во второй тур — заметный, но рутинный итог
Рутинные происшествия: ранение при обвале породы и разгром наркобанды
ar: اكتمال الانتخابات المحلية بسلاسة، مع جولات إعادة في 45 بلدية
سباق انتخابات عمدة ليوبليانا يذهب إلى جولة إعادة، وهي نتيجة لافتة لكنها روتينية
حوادث روتينية: إصابة بسبب انهيار صخري وضبط عصابة مخدرات
fa: انتخابات محلی با نظم کامل برگزار شد و دور دوم در ۴۵ شهرداری انجام می‌شود
رقابت شهرداری لیوبلیانا به دور دوم کشیده شد، نتیجه‌ای قابل توجه اما روتین
حوادث روتین: زخمی شدن بر اثر ریزش سنگ و کشف باند مواد مخدر
zh: 地方选举顺利完成，45个市进行决选
卢布尔雅那市长选举进入决选，结果值得关注但属于例行情况
例行事件：落石致伤和毒品团伙被破获

summary.en: In Haiti, gangs carried out their largest attack yet against the newly deployed international Gang Suppression Force, with at least 4-5 Salvadoran soldiers missing or kidnapped. BINUH recorded more than 1,100 deaths in two months, gangs are launching new attacks in Artibonite, and the UN Security Council notes that elections remain suspended. Routine news such as school openings, cultural events and candidate statements does not change the picture; widespread violence and the collapse of state capacity keep the score very low.

en: Gangs' largest attack on the international force, with Salvadoran soldiers missing
More than 1,100 deaths and 440 injured in two months, according to BINUH data
Gang attack on Petite-Rivière in Artibonite
Elections suspended over security concerns, stalling the political process
Football-related tensions with the Dominican Republic (secondary)

summary.en: Gangs ambushed a foreign-led security force, leaving four Salvadoran soldiers missing and prompting a US embassy warning and more Guatemalan troops. Partial positives, such as 2,000+ new police officers integrated and continued police operations in Kenscoff, do not offset the violence, and the election calendar remains unresolved.

en: Gang ambush on foreign GSF troops; four Salvadoran soldiers missing
Guatemala sending additional troops amid escalating attacks
2,000+ new police officers integrated into the PNH

summary.en: Haiti's period was dominated by gang violence: an attack on foreign troops described as the largest since the new force began operating, and the kidnapping of Salvadoran soldiers followed by a announced military rescue operation. Elections have been postponed and a suspected cyberattack has disrupted banks, with only minor positive items such as a tax-code notice and a corporate loyalty launch.

en: Gang attack on foreign troops, biggest since new force began
Abduction of Salvadoran soldiers and military rescue operation
Elections postponed amid gang pressure on security

summary.en: Violent gang fighting and the kidnapping of four Salvadoran soldiers dominate the period, with a military rescue mission launched and the Dominican border militarized. Some routine positive items (a diplomatic post, cultural and institutional launches) and weather alerts do not offset the serious security pressure.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers kidnapped by gangs; rescue mission launched
Violent combat reported near the Dominican border; border militarized
Foreign troop deployment approved by CARICOM amid gang violence

summary.en: Gang violence dominates the period: four Salvadoran soldiers were reported kidnapped, Salvadoran and other foreign troops were deployed to search for them, and 7,250 people were displaced by armed violence in Artibonite. Coverage also cites recent massacres in Kenscoff, and the negative news tone is well below the world average, while routine economic and cultural items are minor offsets.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers reported kidnapped by gangs; foreign troop deployment
7,250 people displaced by armed violence in Petite-Rivière de l'Artibonite
Reports of massacres in Kenscoff and calls for accountability

summary.en: Four Salvadoran soldiers operating in Haiti were ambushed and their bodies were found, prompting a major Salvadoran military deployment amid gang violence and regional tension. Other news includes a diphtheria resurgence and a crowded presidential election field, with few signs of institutional progress.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers ambushed by gangs and found dead
Major Salvadoran military operation and troop deployment into Haiti
Diphtheria cases rising in Haiti

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by gang-driven violence and displacement in Artibonite, orange security alerts in five departments, and Dominican Republic border reinforcements with two battalions. A dispute over remains possibly belonging to missing Salvadoran soldiers adds diplomatic tension, while electoral candidacy filings are routine.

en: Gang violence causing population displacement in Artibonite
Five departments under orange security alert
Dominican Republic deploying two battalions to border

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious security problems: the disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers, foreign troop deployments, gang advances, self-defence groups forming, and a loud explosion in Port-au-Prince. Flooding, a critical press-freedom situation and very negative news tone (-1.93 vs. a world average of -0.52) add to the strain, with only the U-15 World Cup win as a bright spot.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers disappeared; Bukele deploys elite troops
Self-defence groups formed to stop gang advances
Flooding and intempéries causing serious difficulties across zones

summary.en: Haiti's day was dominated by a gang ambush that left four Salvadoran UN-backed force members missing, prompting a rapid deployment of about 1,000 more troops, alongside deadly flooding and landslides with several deaths. Minor positives, such as a youth football win and a water-access project, do not offset the serious security and disaster problems.

en: Gang ambush leaves four Salvadoran force members missing; reports of deaths
Around 1,000 Salvadoran troops rushed in; security escalation
Heavy rains cause flooding, landslides, deaths and missing people

summary.en: Haiti's day was dominated by escalating gang violence and a military crisis: an ambush left Salvadoran soldiers missing, about 2,000 Salvadoran troops were deployed, and elections were postponed to July 2027. Nearly 6 million people face severe hunger, and flood deaths add to a major humanitarian strain.

en: Elections postponed again to July 2027 amid violence
Salvadoran troop deployment after ambush; four soldiers missing
Nearly 6 million facing severe hunger; famine worsening

summary.en: Haiti faces serious strain over the period: elections were postponed to July 2027, about 6 million people face severe hunger, floods are being reported, and gangs kidnapped four Salvadoran soldiers, prompting a deployment of over 2,000 foreign troops. Modest positives, such as an electrification plan, a city-centre stabilisation project and resumed US flights, do not offset the security and humanitarian picture.

en: Elections postponed to July 2027 after years of delays
Nearly 6 million people in severe hunger, per UN report
Over 2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed after soldiers were kidnapped by gangs

summary.en: The period is dominated by El Salvador's deployment of about 2,000 troops to Haiti after four soldiers went missing, alongside reports of record hunger and frequent telecom fibre cuts. Routine diplomatic and police-recruitment news is present but overshadowed by a foreign military intervention and sovereignty concerns.

en: Foreign military deployment of about 2,000 Salvadoran troops amid gang violence
Record hunger levels reported by multiple outlets
Abduction of four soldiers triggering a rescue operation

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes security steps, including 2,000 Salvadoran troops starting patrols and 1,189 new police graduating, with a postponed election calendar (first round moved to July 2027). Allegations that Salvadoran forces bombed civilians, and a negative news tone well below the world average, keep the score in the serious-problems range rather than crisis.

en: Election first round postponed to July 2027, straining institutions
2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed for street patrols against gangs
Allegations of civilian bombings by Salvadoran forces, denied by Bukele

summary.en: Foreign military operations against gangs, including a search for four missing soldiers and NGO allegations of civilian bombings, dominate the period, alongside ongoing insecurity that keeps tourism and travel suspended. Partial positives, such as American Airlines resuming flights to Cap-Haitien and regional logistics support for the international mission, do not offset the serious security and humanitarian concerns.

en: Salvadoran military offensive against gangs; civilian bombing allegations denied
NGO and MSF calls to protect civilians and medical facilities
Royal Caribbean extends cruise suspension to Haiti until 2028

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes serious security and humanitarian strain, including over 4,000 deaths January to October, a hunger crisis affecting about 6 million people, and intensifying gang clashes. Partial positives include the resumption of American Airlines flights, a 1,189-officer police graduation, and a gang leader's request for UN dialogue.

en: Over 4,000 killed January to October amid gang violence
Gang clashes intensify; leader requests UN-mediated dialogue
Nearly 6 million face severe food insecurity

summary.en: A Salvadoran-backed security operation against gangs in the Cul-de-Sac plain has produced clashes and reported deaths, and a gang leader is warning of reprisals and seeking UN mediation. Routine economic items, such as an airline's return and diaspora investment appeals, offer only minor offsetting positives.

en: Foreign-backed military operation against gangs in Cul-de-Sac plain
Reported deaths in clashes; gang leader warns of reprisals
Gang leader seeks UN mediation amid rising violence

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by a Salvadoran military deployment against gangs, with an ambush, reported deaths of Salvadoran troops, and intensifying clashes. Partial positives include announced election dates, the prime minister's public backing for the operation, and routine health and education news, but the security situation is clearly serious.

en: Gang ambush killed or left missing four Salvadoran troops; vehicle found burned
Salvadoran military deployment launched; clashes with gangs intensify
Haiti announces new election dates amid ongoing gang fighting

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by a Salvadoran military offensive against gangs, warnings of civilian bloodbath, and four missing Salvadoran soldiers whose burned vehicle was found. Food insecurity affects 5.94 million people and the tourism cruise stop at Labadee has been cancelled, while routine diplomacy and electoral preparations continue.

en: Salvadoran troop offensive against gangs with warnings of civilian harm
Four missing Salvadoran soldiers; burned vehicle found
5.94 million Haitians in food insecurity per CNSA

summary.en: Haiti's period was dominated by gang violence and a foreign military deployment, with gunfights persisting and four Salvadoran troops still missing. Partial positives included the reported killing of gang leader Mathias Saintil and an outreach offer from a powerful gang to the disarmament group, alongside routine administrative news.

en: Gang leader Mathias Saintil reported killed in police drone operation
Powerful gang reaches out to government disarmament group amid gunfights
Four Salvadoran troops still missing after gang ambush; burned vehicle found

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes security escalation, with Salvadoran troops operating against gangs and gang leader Mathias Saintil reported killed by drone strike, and some positive signals, including a prevention and recovery pact entering into force and a gang reaching out for peace. Foreign coverage flags risks of escalation and the death toll, and GDELT tone is strongly negative.

en: Gang leader Saintil reported killed in drone operation in Cité-Soleil
Prevention and recovery pact for Haiti entered into force
Foreign troop deployment raises escalation and civilian risk concerns

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by an intensified security offensive: a gang boss was reportedly killed in a drone strike, a gang has reportedly sought talks, and about 2,000 Salvadoran troops are joining operations. Ongoing gang violence, missing foreign nationals and street demands for a tougher campaign keep the score in the serious-problems range, though the World Bank reform plan and election preparations offer some counterweight.

en: Gang leader Mathias Saintil reportedly killed in drone strike or shooting
Gang reportedly seeks talks via letter to the UN
Salvadoran troop deployment of about 2,000 soldiers into Haiti

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by an ongoing security crisis: a Salvadoran military offensive against gangs with unclear rules and reports of civilian harm, a declared humanitarian emergency in Arcahaie, and continued kidnappings, partly offset by a freed kidnap victim and election-preparation steps. Institutions are functioning, but the gang conflict and foreign-troop controversy weigh heavily.

en: Salvadoran troop offensive against gangs with unclear rules and civilian-harm allegations
Arcahaie declared in a humanitarian emergency amid gang violence
Education official freed after Artibonite kidnapping

summary.en: Foreign Salvadoran air strikes destroyed a major gang headquarters in Haiti, with reports of about 20 dead, and the US has questioned the operation. Haitian officials back the partnership and election preparations continue, but the period is dominated by violent insecurity and contested foreign intervention.

en: Salvadoran air strikes on a gang HQ, reportedly killing about 20
US and Dominican positions on the Salvadoran offensive diverge
Election preparation and women's mobilisation continue despite insecurity

summary.en: Haiti's day was dominated by a Salvadoran military offensive against gangs, including the reported destruction of the 400 Mawozo headquarters, amid a UN count of 1,167 deaths in Q3 2026 from violence. Election-related sanctions concerns and the foreign military operation add pressure, while minor positives such as a Cap-Haïtien–Canada agreement were small by comparison.

en: Salvadoran military offensive against gangs and reported gang HQ destruction
BINUH report: 1,167 deaths and 459 injuries in Q3 2026
G7 concern over sanctioned figures running in upcoming elections

summary.en: Security operations, including Salvadoran-backed forces retaking Sylvio Cator Stadium from gangs, dominate coverage, set against a UN report of over 1,000 killings in three months. Modest positives, such as an IDB health grant, reopened trade with the Dominican Republic and resumed flights, do not offset the widespread violence.

en: UN report: over 1,000 killed in Haiti, July to September
Foreign-backed forces retake Sylvio Cator Stadium from gangs
Gang leader targeted; sustained armed operations in Port-au-Prince area

summary.en: A large foreign-led military offensive against gangs in Port-au-Prince, with 2,500 troops, reports of gang deaths, and the recapture of a major stadium, dominates the period. G7 calls for civilian protection, reported discovery of human skulls, and legality concerns over the mission point to serious violence and institutional strain, though not state collapse.

en: Salvadoran-led offensive against gangs with 2,500 troops in Port-au-Prince
Recapture of Sylvio Cator stadium; reported human skulls found inside
G7 statement urging protection of civilians amid operations

summary.en: Foreign-led security operations with Salvadoran troops gained ground, including a reported gang boss killing and recovery of a stadium from gangs. However, the UN warned of intensified clashes, and deportation hardship and a negative news tone persist.

en: Salvadoran troops deployed; reported gang boss killed in drone strike
Haiti recovers stadium previously held by gangs
UN warns of intensified clashes raising civilian risk

summary.en: Gang violence remains severe, with reports of farmers killed, kidnappings and mass deportations from the Dominican Republic. Partly offsetting this, candidate registration for the long-delayed elections closed and foreign security deployments, including Salvadoran troops and a UN-backed mission, advanced.
summary.ja: ギャングによる暴力は依然として深刻で、農民の殺害、誘拐、ドミニカ共和国からの大量国外追放が報じられている。一方で、長く延期されてきた選挙の立候補受付が締め切られ、サルバドル軍や国連が支援する部隊を含む外国の治安部隊の展開が進んだことで、これを一部相殺している。
summary.ko: 갱단 폭력은 여전히 심각하며, 농민 살해, 납치, 도미니카 공화국에서의 대규모 강제추방 사례가 보고되고 있다. 이와 달리, 오랫동안 연기되어 온 선거의 후보 등록이 마감되었고, 살바도르 군대와 유엔이 지원하는 임무단을 포함한 외국 치안 병력의 배치가 진전되었다.
summary.hi: गिरोह हिंसा अब भी गंभीर बनी हुई है, जिसमें किसानों की हत्या, अपहरण और डोमिनिकन गणराज्य से बड़े पैमाने पर निर्वासन की रिपोर्टें शामिल हैं। इसके आंशिक संतुलन के रूप में, लंबे समय से टले चुनावों के लिए उम्मीदवार पंजीकरण बंद हुआ और सैल्वाडोरन सैनिकों तथा संयुक्त राष्ट्र समर्थित मिशन सहित विदेशी सुरक्षा तैनाती आगे बढ़ी।
summary.el: Η βία των συμμοριών παραμένει σοβαρή, με αναφορές για δολοφονίες αγροτών, απαγωγές και μαζικές απελάσεις από τη Δομινικανή Δημοκρατία. Εν μέρει αντισταθμιστικά, έληξε η υποβολή υποψηφιοτήτων για τις εκλογές που καθυστερούσαν πολύ καιρό και προχώρησαν ξένες αστυνομικές αποστολές, συμπεριλαμβανομένων σαλβαδορέικων στρατευμάτων και αποστολής με τη στήριξη του ΟΗΕ.
summary.tr: Çete şiddeti ciddi düzeyde sürüyor; çiftçilerin öldürüldüğüne, kaçırma olaylarına ve Dominik Cumhuriyeti'nden toplu sınır dışı edilmelere ilişkin haberler bulunuyor. Bunu kısmen dengeleyecek şekilde, uzun süredir ertelenen seçimler için aday kaydı sona erdi ve Salvadorlu askerler ile BM destekli misyon dahil yabancı güvenlik konuşlandırmaları ilerledi.
summary.es: La violencia de las pandillas sigue siendo grave, con informes de agricultores asesinados, secuestros y deportaciones masivas desde la República Dominicana. En parte compensando esto, cerró el registro de candidatos para las elecciones largamente aplazadas y avanzaron los despliegues de seguridad extranjeros, incluidas las tropas salvadoreñas y una misión respaldada por la ONU.
summary.fr: La violence des gangs reste grave, avec des informations faisant état d'agriculteurs tués, d'enlèvements et d'expulsions massives depuis la République dominicaine. En partie pour compenser cela, l'enregistrement des candidats aux élections longtemps reportées a pris fin et les déploiements de sécurité étrangers, notamment des troupes salvadoriennes et une mission soutenue par l'ONU, ont progressé.
summary.de: Die Gewalt durch Banden bleibt gravierend; es gibt Berichte über getötete Landwirte, Entführungen und Massenabschiebungen aus der Dominikanischen Republik. Teilweise ausgleichend wurde die Kandidatenregistrierung für die lange verschobenen Wahlen abgeschlossen, und ausländische Sicherheitseinsätze, darunter salvadorianische Truppen und eine von den Vereinten Nationen unterstützte Mission, kamen voran.
summary.pt: A violência das gangues continua grave, com relatos de agricultores mortos, sequestros e deportações em massa da República Dominicana. Em parte compensando isso, o registro de candidatos para as eleições há muito adiadas foi encerrado e avançaram as implantações de segurança estrangeiras, incluindo tropas salvadorenhas e uma missão apoiada pela ONU.
summary.it: La violenza delle bande rimane grave, con segnalazioni di agricoltori uccisi, rapimenti ed espulsioni di massa dalla Repubblica Dominicana. A parziale compensazione, si è chiusa la registrazione delle candidature per le elezioni a lungo rinviate e sono avanzati i dispiegamenti di forze di sicurezza straniere, tra cui truppe salvadoregne e una missione sostenuta dall'ONU.
summary.ru: Насилие банд остается сильным: поступают сообщения об убийстве фермеров, похищениях и массовых депортациях из Доминиканской Республики. Отчасти этому противовесом стали закрытие регистрации кандидатов на давно отложенные выборы и продвижение развертывания иностранных сил безопасности, включая сальвадорских военных и миссию при поддержке ООН.
summary.ar: لا يزال العنف الذي تمارسه العصابات شديدًا، مع تقارير عن مقتل مزارعين وعمليات خطف وترحيل جماعي من جمهورية الدومينيكان. وفي المقابل، أُغلق باب تسجيل المرشحين للانتخابات المتأخرة منذ زمن طويل، وتقدم نشر قوات أمنية أجنبية، بما في ذلك القوات السلفادورية وبعثة مدعومة من الأمم المتحدة.
summary.fa: خشونت باندهای مسلح همچنان شدید است و گزارش‌هایی از کشته شدن کشاورزان، ربوده شدن افراد و اخراج‌های گسترده از جمهوری دومینیکن منتشر شده است. در مقابل، ثبت‌نام نامزدها برای انتخاباتی که مدت‌ها به تعویق افتاده بود به پایان رسید و استقرار نیروهای امنیتی خارجی، از جمله نظامیان السالوادور و یک ماموریت با پشتیبانی سازمان ملل، پیشرفت کرد.
summary.zh: 帮派暴力依然严重，有报道称农民遇害、遭绑架，并有大规模从多米尼加共和国遣返的情况。与此形成一定平衡的是，久拖未决的选举候选人登记已经结束，外国安全力量的部署也有所推进，包括萨尔瓦多军队和获联合国支持的特派团。

en: Gang killings and kidnappings continue amid new security operations
Candidate enrollment closes for first national elections in a decade
Salvadoran troops and UN-backed mission deploy against gangs

10年ぶりの国政選挙に向けた立候補登録が締め切られた

summary.en: The period is proceeding largely normally in Malaysia, but cross-border haze is putting pressure on health and education. The deregistration of the main opposition alliance, Perikatan Nasional, signals institutional and political tension ahead of the election. Positive developments such as ECRL ticket prices, the economic freedom score and investment news partly offset these effects. The stock market is down 4% on a monthly basis.

en: Haze from Indonesia: unhealthy air quality in 28 regions, measures for SPM examinations
Deregistration of the main opposition bloc, Perikatan Nasional, and political tension ahead of the election
ECRL passenger fares and preparations for commercial operation, investment and infrastructure news
Highest score on the economic freedom index since 1970
KLCI fell 3.96% over the last month

summary.en: The period is mostly routine business and social news: investment deals, cruise and tourism announcements, and a cross-border crackdown. Offsetting these are unhealthy haze readings in 22 districts and the de-registration of the main opposition bloc ahead of elections, which weighs on institutional confidence.

en: Deregistration of Perikatan Nasional ahead of elections
Unhealthy haze readings across 22 districts, hitting tourism
Large investment deals: DayOne financing and Keria industrial city

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine business, investment and cultural news (data centre, Dassault office, refinery JV, Watsons Plus launch) with a stable stock market. Negatives are limited to haze, a Sabah border security concern, drainage complaints and a Middle East crisis remark, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary period.

en: New data centre and Dassault office signal investment and digital economy growth
Precious metal refinery joint venture and Watsons Plus launch
Haze impacts and Sabah border security concerns weigh slightly

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance news with modest positives, including RM1.2bil for school repairs, flood mitigation pledges and a large investment approval in Kedah. Negatives include the closure of a Johor factory affecting about 300 workers, 54 Malaysians still missing in Nepal, and unhealthy air in 16 areas. The KLCI was flat, so the overall picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: RM1.2bil allocated for school repairs and upgrades nationwide
Kedah approved RM185.9bn in investments, projected 51,000+ jobs
Lee Biscuits closing Johor factory, about 300 workers affected

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Malaysia: haze pushed air quality into unhealthy ranges, Sarawak's assembly was set for dissolution ahead of an election, and the opposition PN survived a deregistration threat. Negative items (a factory closure with about 300 jobs lost, a school axe attack) are offset by a flat-to-slightly-up stock market and a news tone better than the world average.

en: Haze with unhealthy air quality readings in many areas
Sarawak state assembly dissolution paving way for election
PN survives deregistration for now; internal rifts noted

summary.en: A routine news day dominated by a haze episode that is easing (Johor schools reopening Oct 26) and a government-announced US$50bn tech investment, offset by coalition friction ahead of the Melaka election. Markets were flat and the tone was somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: US$50bn international tech investment announced by PM
Johor schools reopening as haze conditions improve
Haze still severe in Serian and Sarawak spots

summary.en: The period mixes major positive investment news, including a reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI and data-centre plan and Moody's praise for Malaysia's data-centre positioning, with localised harms from Kedah and Penang floods, a Penang landslide death, and haze-driven school closures and an Indonesian goods boycott. The GDELT tone (-0.05 versus a world average of -0.71) and a flat-to-slightly-down market point to a generally steady day with clear net-positive economic signals.

en: SoftBank reported US$50 billion Malaysia AI and data-centre investment plan
Moody's notes Malaysia well positioned as regional data-centre hub
Kedah and Penang flooding and landslide casualties; evacuee numbers rising

summary.en: The day was mostly routine, with clear positives in large foreign investment pledges (a reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI plan and a $7.7b Johor solar financing deal) and easing haze. Negatives included a death in police custody, renewed calls for oversight, a Penang construction accident and flood evacuees in Kedah.

en: Reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI and data centre investment plan
DBS, Maybank and IFC $7.7b Johor solar financing
Haze clearing in most areas, schools reopening in Johor

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with positive economic and social items: haze cleared nationwide, IPO fundraising led ASEAN, Fitch forecast Islamic finance growth, and tourism arrivals were strong. Negatives were limited to a fatal maritime enforcement accident, a party crisis in Negeri Sembilan and smuggling arrests, and the market was flat to slightly up.

en: Haze dissipated; air quality back to healthy levels nationwide
IPO fundraising of RM6.1bn leads ASEAN; Fitch sees Islamic finance growth
Sept trade and tourism arrivals (32.2m Jan-Sept) remain solid

summary.en: A routine news day with several constructive items: trade with BRICS up 20%, cruise arrivals in Penang up 14%, RTS Link progress, and a strengthened geopark status. Negatives include the Nepali worker recruitment halt, AI chip smuggling seizures and criminal defamation criticism, and the market was flat.

en: BRICS trade rose 20% to over RM480bil this year
Singapore cruise passengers up 14.25%, Penang seeks cruise homeport status
Gombak-Hulu Langat geopark status reaffirmed; RTS Link emergency drill

summary.en: The period is mostly positive: the first FA-50M jet was delivered, a US$600mil rare-earth refinery and a large floating solar project were announced, Penang's September exports rose 96.2%, and Anwar survived a budget vote with Bersatu support. Flood reports and calls for a probe into a deadly Penang landslide weigh on the picture, and the stock market was roughly flat.

en: First FA-50M fighter jet delivered from South Korea
US$600mil rare-earth refinery and floating solar construction announced
Penang September exports up 96.2%

summary.en: The period reads as a mostly routine day, with local government announcements, agricultural and tech-education developments, and a KLCI that rose 0.28% on the day. Negatives include worsening floods in Negeri Sembilan, a safety-driven work stoppage order, and 130 Malaysians arrested in a Pakistan-linked scam, but none signals a broader crisis.

en: Worsening floods in Negeri Sembilan, improving in Kedah
Penang budget measures: newlywed aid and tourism funding
Scam-network arrests involving 130 Malaysians

summary.en: The period shows routine governance and economic news: a planned US$600 million rare-earth plant, a regional push on social media regulation, and a peaceful Melaka state election campaign. Flood preparations and a seized AI-chip shipment are ordinary administrative matters, and the KLCI and news tone are slightly positive.

en: US$600 million US-backed rare-earth plant investment announced
Melaka election candidates confirmed with no clashes reported
Regional cooperation push on social media giants

summary.en: The period was largely routine: export and trade-surplus growth, delivery of the first FA-50M jets, and a modestly rising stock index, offset by deadly fires in Sabah's water villages and ordinary state-level political sparring. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average, supporting a mildly positive reading.

en: Trade surplus forecast to rise 15-20%; exports up 71.8% in Penang
First FA-50M fighter jets delivered to Malaysia's air force
Deadly Sabah water-village blazes expose housing safety gaps

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with several clearly positive economic signals: a record-size REIT IPO, large Johor-Singapore SEZ investment approvals, and a TotalEnergies gas stake deal. Concerns include the Utusan newspaper crisis, halal-check questions, data-centre worries and warnings about electronics-sector risk, and the market is flat.

en: IOI REIT RM2.1bil IPO, Malaysia's largest REIT listing
Johor-Singapore SEZ reports about US$21.8-28bil in approved investments
TotalEnergies to acquire 30% stake in two offshore gas fields

summary.en: The period is mostly routine with several positive business and institutional items: energy deals with TotalEnergies and PTTEP, an IPO prospectus, university rankings and a Michelin star. Negatives are limited to localized flash floods, a bridge collapse, road deaths and a critique of airport drug screening, and the stock market is flat.

en: TotalEnergies stake acquisition and PTTEP gas field accords
University rankings and Michelin star for a KL restaurant
Flash floods and a bridge collapse in Selangor

summary.en: The period was clearly positive, led by a US$15 billion Google data-centre investment that the PM and foreign media both reported, alongside 'resilient economy' coverage, a record ranking gain in financial inclusion, and a settlement restoring state funding. Minor negatives (poultry farm complaints, a murder charge, embezzlement denials) were routine and did not change the picture.

en: Google to invest US$15bn in data centres in 2027-2028
Official and media reports of economic resilience and expansion
Largest ranking gain in Global Financial Inclusion Index

summary.en: A largely routine day with several positive economic and infrastructure stories, including a Penang LRT contract award, Microsoft and Daiso expansions, and Port Klang growth plans. Offsetting concerns include monsoon flooding, a drug-trafficking warning and the Najib fine-for-house-arrest arrangement, and the KLCI was flat over the week.

en: Penang LRT cross-sea contract awarded worth RM2.69 billion
Microsoft expands cloud infrastructure; Daiso opens largest warehouse
Northeast Monsoon flooding and Johor flash-flood mitigation projects

summary.en: A mostly routine news day: Deepavali travel, a police leadership reshuffle, and a Selangor royal jubilee, plus some investment news. The main story is friction between the palace and the attorney-general over Najib's house-arrest order, which adds institutional tension, and the KLCI fell 1.18% on the day.

en: Najib house-arrest order halted, palace and attorney-general disagree
KLCI down 1.18% in one day, flat over the week
Routine Deepavali travel and police reshuffle coverage

summary.en: Routine state election campaigning in Malacca and Sarawak, investment and tech news, and minor incidents dominate the period. A public dispute between the King and the attorney-general over Najib's house arrest adds institutional friction, and the market fell 1.18% in one day, though the weekly and monthly moves are flat.

en: King and attorney-general dispute over Najib's house arrest order
Malacca and Sarawak state election campaigns under way
Routine investment and tech-training news; minor local incidents

summary.en: A mostly routine day dominated by Deepavali festivities, a Melaka by-election campaign, and a court decision allowing ex-PM Najib house arrest, with flood evacuations and cybersecurity incidents as the main negatives. The 5G coverage milestone and a flat KLCI point to a stable, slightly positive period.

en: Court approves Najib house arrest, a notable but non-crisis legal development
Selangor flood evacuees rise, a localised weather-related strain
5G coverage reaches 90%, nine months ahead of schedule

summary.en: A deadly water surge in Selangor (5 dead, 3 missing) and flood evacuations are the main negatives, but they are localized. Offsetting them are a US$1.85bn SoftBank/Grab AI infrastructure investment, a 10.7% rise in Q3 manufacturing sales, and routine governance and housing news, with GDELT tone slightly better than the world average.

en: Selangor water surge kills five and leaves three missing
SoftBank/Grab US$1.85bn AI infrastructure investment announced
Q3 manufacturing sales up 10.7%

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: large foreign AI investments and a housing target stand against flash floods and a boat sinking with missing crew, a water-payment dispute, and a cabinet resignation. The KLCI dipped slightly, so the overall picture is close to an ordinary day with a small positive tilt.

en: SoftBank and Grab $1.85bn AI infrastructure investment plan
Flash flood and boat sinking leave several people missing
Minister's resignation and Najib's move to house arrest add political noise

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: foreign investment projects, a Penang water agreement approved by shareholders, and infrastructure progress on the RTS Link. Negatives are limited to a police machete attack, state election politics and the Najib house-arrest debate, and the KLCI is slightly down over the week.

en: Penang water agreement approved by 97.93% of shareholders
Eppendorf €40mil plant groundbreaking and other German investment
LSS5+ solar project signed; RTS Link on schedule

summary.en: The period looks routine: political sparring over religious and ethnic rhetoric, a police-officer attack that ended with the attacker shot dead, and a Megaspeed AI-chip probe, set against solid Penang GDP growth and a slightly negative stock market. No clear crisis or breakthrough, and the GDELT tone is milder than the world average.

en: Penang GDP grew 7.3%, above the national 5.2% rate
Ministry denies clearing Megaspeed; AI chip re-export probe continues
Bursa Malaysia closed slightly lower amid cautious sentiment

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a Melaka state election campaign, a chip-smuggling probe affecting data centres, and defence procurement and infrastructure announcements. Market moves are small (KLCI -0.21% on the day) and the news tone is slightly more negative than the world average, so the score sits just above a typical day.

en: Melaka state election testing the federal coalition's cohesion
Chip-smuggling probe rattling data centre sector
Defence deliveries: FA-50M jets and missile upgrades confirmed

summary.en: The period was dominated by the Melaka state election, where the BN-PN alliance won a landslide over Pakatan Harapan, a notable political setback for PM Anwar that was handled through normal electoral channels. Chip-diversion probes and US chip-curb worries add mild economic risk, while the market was roughly flat and cultural and local news was routine.

en: Melaka election landslide for BN-PN, a setback for Anwar's coalition
Police probe into alleged Nvidia chip diversion since April 2025
KLCI down 2.1% over the week, with a mild 24-hour dip

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: investment and data-centre news, a Michelin star for a Penang restaurant, and an Indonesian apology over haze all lean positive. Flooding displacing over 2,500 people and political maneuvering in Negeri Sembilan and Penang are the main negatives. The KLCI is slightly down over the week but up on the day, and GDELT tone is above the world average.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: notizie su investimenti e data center, una stella Michelin per un ristorante di Penang e le scuse indonesiane per la foschia danno un quadro complessivamente positivo. Le inondazioni che hanno sfollato oltre 2.500 persone e le manovre politiche in Negeri Sembilan e Penang sono i principali aspetti negativi. Il KLCI è leggermente in calo nella settimana ma in rialzo nella giornata, e il tono di GDELT è superiore alla media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период в основном обычный: новости об инвестициях и центрах обработки данных, мишленовская звезда для ресторана в Пенанге и извинения Индонезии за смог в целом носят позитивный характер. Основными негативными факторами являются наводнения, вынудившие более 2500 человек покинуть свои дома, и политические маневры в Негери-Сембилан и Пенанге. Индекс KLCI за неделю немного снизился, но в течение дня вырос, а тональность GDELT выше среднемировой.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: أخبار عن الاستثمارات ومراكز البيانات، ونجمة ميشلان لمطعم في بينانغ، واعتذار إندونيسيا عن الضباب الدخاني كلها تميل إلى الإيجابية. وتشكل الفيضانات التي شردت أكثر من 2500 شخص والمناورات السياسية في نيغيري سمبيلان وبينانغ أبرز الجوانب السلبية. ويشهد مؤشر KLCI انخفاضاً طفيفاً خلال الأسبوع لكنه يرتفع خلال اليوم، كما أن نبرة GDELT أعلى من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌مانند است: اخبار سرمایه‌گذاری و مراکز داده، یک ستاره میشلین برای رستورانی در پенанگ، و عذرخواهی اندونزی بابت آلودگی دود همگی به سمت مثبت متمایل‌اند. سیلاب‌هایی که بیش از ۲۵۰۰ نفر را آواره کرده و مانورهای سیاسی در نگری سمبیلان و پенанگ مهم‌ترین جنبه‌های منفی‌اند. شاخص KLCI در طول هفته اندکی کاهش یافته اما در همان روز افزایش داشته است، و لحن GDELT بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体属于常规情况：投资和数据中心新闻、槟城一家餐厅获得米其林星级，以及印尼就霾害致歉，总体偏向积极。洪水导致逾2500人流离失所，以及森美兰和槟城的政治操作是主要负面因素。KLCI指数一周内略有下跌，但当日上涨；GDELT语气高于全球平均水平。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin: yatırım ve veri merkezi haberleri, bir Penang restoranına Michelin yıldızı ve Endonezya'nın duman nedeniyle özür açıklaması olumlu yönde. 2.500'den fazla kişinin yerinden edildiği sel ve Negeri Sembilan ile Penang'daki siyasi manevralar başlıca olumsuz gelişmeler. KLCI haftalık bazda hafifçe düşerken günlük bazda yükseldi; GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının üzerinde.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: noticias de inversión y centros de datos, una estrella Michelin para un restaurante de Penang y una disculpa indonesia por la neblina de humo, todas con tono positivo. Las inundaciones que desplazaron a más de 2.500 personas y las maniobras políticas en Negeri Sembilan y Penang son los principales aspectos negativos. El KLCI bajó ligeramente en la semana, pero subió en el día; el tono de GDELT está por encima del promedio mundial.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : les nouvelles sur les investissements et les centres de données, une étoile Michelin pour un restaurant de Penang et des excuses indonésiennes pour la brume de pollution penchent toutes vers le positif. Les inondations ayant déplacé plus de 2 500 personnes et les manœuvres politiques à Negeri Sembilan et à Penang constituent les principaux points négatifs. Le KLCI a légèrement baissé sur la semaine mais a progressé sur la journée, et le ton de GDELT est supérieur à la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Meldungen über Investitionen und Rechenzentren, ein Michelin-Stern für ein Restaurant in Penang und eine indonesische Entschuldigung wegen des Smogs wirken positiv. Überschwemmungen, die mehr als 2.500 Menschen vertrieben haben, sowie politische Manöver in Negeri Sembilan und Penang sind die wichtigsten negativen Faktoren. Der KLCI verlor im Wochenverlauf leicht, legte aber am Tag zu; der GDELT-Tonwert liegt über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, rotineiro: notícias de investimentos e centros de dados, uma estrela Michelin para um restaurante em Penang e um pedido de desculpas indonésio pela neblina de fumaça apontam para o lado positivo. As enchentes que deslocaram mais de 2.500 pessoas e as manobras políticas em Negeri Sembilan e Penang são os principais fatores negativos. O KLCI caiu levemente na semana, mas subiu no dia; o tom do GDELT está acima da média mundial.
summary.ja: この期間は大半が平常どおりのニュースで、投資やデータセンター関連の報道、ペナンのレストランのミシュラン星獲得、ヘイズ(煙害)をめぐるインドネシアの謝罪などは、いずれも前向きな傾向を示している。2,500人以上が避難を余儀なくされた洪水と、ヌグリ・スンビランおよびペナンでの政治的駆け引きが主なマイナス要因である。KLCIは週単位では小幅に下落したものの、当日は上昇した。GDELTのトーンは世界平均を上回っている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간의 뉴스는 대체로 평범한 수준입니다. 투자 및 데이터센터 관련 소식, 페낭 식당의 미쉐린 별 획득, 연무 문제에 대한 인도네시아의 사과 등은 모두 긍정적인 흐름을 보입니다. 2,500명 이상이 피해를 입은 홍수와 느그리 스미란 및 페낭의 정치적 움직임이 주요 부정적 요인입니다. KLCI는 주간으로는 소폭 하락했지만 당일에는 상승했습니다. GDELT 톤은 세계 평균보다 높습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की अधिकांश खबरें सामान्य हैं: निवेश और डेटा-सेंटर से जुड़े समाचार, पेनांग के एक रेस्торां को मिशेलिन स्टार मिलना, और वायु प्रदूषण (हेज़) पर इंडोनेशिया का माफ़ी मांगना, इन सभी का झुकाव सकारात्मक है। 2,500 से अधिक लोगों को विस्थापित करने वाली बाढ़ और नेगेरी सेम्बिलान तथा पेनांग में राजनीतिक दांव-पेंच मुख्य नकारात्मक पहलू हैं। KLCI सप्ताह भर में थोड़ा नीचे है, लेकिन उस दिन ऊपर बंद हुआ। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι στην πλειονότητά της συνηθισμένη: ειδήσεις για επενδύσεις και κέντρα δεδομένων, ένα αστέρι Michelin για εστιατόριο στο Penang και η επίσημη συγγνώμη της Ινδονησίας για την ομίχλη καπνού είναι κατά βάση θετικές. Οι πλημμύρες που εκτόπισαν πάνω από 2.500 άτομα και οι πολιτικοί ελιγμοί στο Negeri Sembilan και στο Penang αποτελούν τα κύρια αρνητικά. Ο δείκτης KLCI είναι ελαφρώς χαμηλότερα στη διάρκεια της εβδομάδας, αλλά υψηλότερα στη σημερινή συνεδρίαση. Ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται πάνω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: Over the past 24 hours, Tanzania news has mainly reflected the routine economic and development agenda: investment initiatives, new flights, a natural gas discovery, a rise in insurance premiums and a bank loan.
